extra.final_summary: The data had several issues affecting the analysis: (1) 'Adeile' in the 'species' column was a misspelling of 'Adelie' and was corrected; (2) 'island' had inconsistent spacing (e.g., ' Torgersen', 'Dream ', ' Dream') and was normalized; (3) two exact duplicate rows were removed; (4) 'sex' labels had case variants ('FEMALE', 'MALE') and were normalized; (5) one row (row 13) had a negative flipper length (-176), which was excluded as invalid; (6) three rows (4, 10, 36) had body mass values outside the plausible range (2500–6500 g), so they were excluded. After these fixes, the average body mass for each sex was computed on 37 valid rows: female penguins average 4058.75 g, and male penguins average 4707.35 g.
